title: Run the keep-prose sieve over swarming-reference, the largest unpruned file
action: 606 lines, the biggest normative block left. Put every rule through one question: if an agent broke it, would a hook, a test, or a human at a gate catch it? Caught by a hook or test -> one line pointing at the enforcing surface. Caught by a gate reviewer -> keep as prose, one home. Caught by nobody -> it is a default, not a law; say so or delete it. Then run the wave-close regen: render-skill-trees, onboard --repo-root . --apply, release-manifest --write.

truths: every surviving rule is enforced, gate-checkable, or named a default
